description: Istota private push v1 test vectors. Every key here is a test key derived from its label as SHA-256(label); none is used anywhere else. See README.md and docs/reference/private-push-v1.md.

sender.label: istota private push v1 test sender key

other_sender.label: istota private push v1 test other sender key

device.label: istota private push v1 test device key

other_device.label: istota private push v1 test other device key

positive.name: ascii_chat
positive.description: A chat alert in the smallest bucket.

positive.name: multibyte_at_caps
positive.description: An 80-character title and 180-character body, all multibyte.

positive.name: bucket_1024
positive.description: A notification whose link fills the 1024-byte bucket.

positive.name: bucket_2048
positive.description: A notification whose link fills the 2048-byte bucket.

positive.name: inbox_fallback
positive.description: A target too large for any bucket, replaced by the inbox target.

positive.name: null_collapse
positive.description: No logical group, so no collapse ID and a null group.

positive.name: null_badge
positive.description: No badge: the header and inner badge are null and aps has none.

negative.name: tampered_header
negative.description: The header's badge changed from 3 to 4 after signing.

negative.name: tampered_ciphertext
negative.description: The last byte of enc || ciphertext has one bit flipped.

negative.name: tampered_signature
negative.description: The last byte of the signature has one bit flipped.

negative.name: wrong_device_key
negative.description: Opened with a device key the header's kid does not name.

negative.name: wrong_sender_key
negative.description: Verified against a sender key the header's sid does not name.

negative.name: duplicate_header_key
negative.description: Signed correctly; the header names badge twice (3, then 4).

negative.name: padded_length_inconsistent
negative.description: Signed and encrypted correctly; the length prefix is one byte past the bucket.

negative.name: padding_not_smallest_bucket
negative.description: Signed and encrypted correctly; a 512-byte plaintext padded to 1024.

negative.name: inner_mismatch
negative.description: Signed and encrypted correctly; the inner binding differs.

negative.name: decrypt_failure
negative.description: Signed correctly and naming the device's kid, but encrypted to another key.
